sloka: कुमुदो द्विविदो मैन्दो नीलः शरभ एव च।पादपैर्गिरिशृङ्गैश्च युगपत् समभिद्रवन् ।। ६.७१.३९ ।।
transliteration: kumudo dvivido maindo nīlaḥ śarabha eva ca।pādapairgiriśṛṅgaiśca yugapat samabhidravan ।। 6.71.39 ।।

translations.english: Kumuda, Dwivida, Mainda, Neela, even Sarabha, all at once assailed him with trees and mountain peaks.
